/**
 * @name Symlink following in file lock operations
 * @description File lock operations that follow symlinks without validation may be vulnerable to TOCTOU attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-symlink-following
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // Check for os.open without O_NOFOLLOW
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
    // Check for pathlib operations that might follow symlinks
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["open", "touch", "unlink"]).getACall() or
    // Check for os.stat vs os.lstat
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("stat").getACall() or
    // Check for os.remove/unlink
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "unlink"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may follow symlinks without proper validation in file locking context."
findings.hypothesis: Check for TOCTOU vulnerabilities where file operations follow symlinks without proper validation, which could allow attackers to manipulate lock files

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name File descriptor leaks
 * @description File operations without proper cleanup can lead to file descriptor exhaustion
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-fd-leak
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-404
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

predicate isFileOpen(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call) {
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
}

predicate hasCloseCall(DataFlow::CallCfgNode openCall) {
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode closeCall, DataFlow::AttrRead attr |
    DataFlow::localFlow(openCall, attr.getObject()) and
    attr.getAttributeName() = "close" and
    closeCall.getFunction() = attr
  )
}

predicate isInWithStatement(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call) {
  exists(With w |
    w.getContextExpr() = call.asExpr()
  )
}

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  isFileOpen(call) and
  not hasCloseCall(call) and
  not isInWithStatement(call)
select call, "File opened without guaranteed cleanup, potentially leading to file descriptor leak."
findings.hypothesis: File operations without proper cleanup can lead to file descriptor exhaustion
